description: SwiftGo — one-hue orange logistics, derived from reference R12. Sans-led, cream ground, brand reserved for actions and state. A third family, different in IA and colour discipline from both existing runs, used to test that the family-config layer generalises.

typography.displayRoleNote: The R12 reference spends nothing on type personality: a single sans, hierarchy by weight and colour. displayStrategy 'sans' resolves the display role to the UI stack.

responsive.mobile: Single column throughout. Shipment list is stacked rows. Package-type grid 2-up. Fixed bottom tab bar (Home / Shipments / Send).
responsive.desktop: Two-column home: active shipment and route panel left, recent shipments right. Package-type grid 4-up. Tab bar hidden; navigation moves into the header.
